achievements.description: You welcomed the sprite and received its blessing.
Defeat your first enemy and claim dominance.
Successfully navigate the trickiest of mazes.

nodes.text: {WAVE}The forest seems normal.{ENDWAVE} {COLOR=RED}Goblins, bugs, and fairies{ENDCOLOR} roam the forest. Nothing out of the ordinary. The forest is still lit by the sun - probably because it's high noon and the trees, so far, are normal.{WAIT=1}

{WAIT=1}
A {COLOR=RED}sprite{ENDCOLOR} lands on my shoulder. {SHAKE}Rumors say these sprites have been blessed{ENDSHAKE}, and their touch can grant {RAINBOW}blessings{ENDRAINBOW} or take them away from me. {COLOR=#FFDB51}Should I shoo it away?{ENDCOLOR}
The {COLOR=RED}sprite{ENDCOLOR} left. Seemingly {WAVE}unagitated{ENDWAVE} by my skeptical attitude towards it.
{COLOR=#66FF00}I checked my stats with an appraisal to find out that my Mana regenerates by 1-20% after each battle.{ENDCOLOR}

I've been documenting the species I've come across, and so far, these life forms can be relocated to a nearby ecosystem outside the forest. The forest was indeed teeming with life. A few meters after the sprite encounter, I saw {COLOR=RED}a bloodied hobgoblin{ENDCOLOR}. {COLOR=RED}Hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} are considered the bottom of the food chain. However, its left hand was cut off - not with a bite mark, but {SHAKE}a sweeping cut{ENDSHAKE}, seemingly of a sword. {COLOR=#FFDB51}Should I help him?{ENDCOLOR}

{COLOR=#66FF00}I battle the goblin's seeming perpetrator. I won and aided the goblin. I used one of my potions to heal it.{ENDCOLOR}
{COLOR=RED}[[-1 Potion]{ENDCOLOR}
I dont think this is part of my job. I dont want the {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins' perpetrators{ENDCOLOR} to be after me. {WAVE}I turned a blind eye{ENDWAVE} to the creature and continued venturing.

As I ventured further, all of a sudden, {SHAKE}I felt a tree branch stop me in my tracks{ENDSHAKE}. I thought I stumbled on a branch, but I couldn't lift my foot as the branch completely wrapped around my foot. I looked back and saw a tree with a pattern of a face. {COLOR=#FFDB51}Is this what they call a {COLOR=RED}Treant{ENDCOLOR}?{ENDCOLOR}{WAIT=1}

The sun starts setting after a couple of meters of walking. Honestly, my legs are getting tired. Luckily, {COLOR=#66FF00}I heard a stream nearby{ENDCOLOR}, which I immediately chased after. I set up camp and sent a letter to the capital through my letter bird. Attached to the letter are the creatures I came across today. I've used one of my food packs for dinner tonight before casting a barrier cloak to protect my camp and leave it invisible. I've settled into my spot in my sleeping bag and dozed off without any issues. {WAIT=2}

achievements.description: Better safe than sorry, I suppose...
Take a leap of faith into unexplored territories.
Resolve a conflict without drawing your weapon.
Meet a terrible and gruesome end.
Restore balance to the spirits of the forest.
Now, getting ladies is a piece of cake.

nodes.text: I've been awakened by {SHAKE}faint rustling{ENDSHAKE} outside the camp. {WAIT=1}I did not fear for my safety as my barrier still stands. I peeked outside my sleeping bag to see {COLOR=RED}Salamanders{ENDCOLOR} drinking from the stream. Normally, {COLOR=RED}salamanders{ENDCOLOR} are found in swamps. Quite interesting how these {COLOR=RED}salamanders{ENDCOLOR} are {SICK}green and not red{ENDSICK}. Their spine is much more protruded, and their eyes shut from side-to-side. Had I not known anything, I'd say they were {COLOR=RED}baby dragons{ENDCOLOR}. After drinking from the stream, {WAVE}they swam along its flow{ENDWAVE}. Truly a curious creature indeed. They'll make my notes for sure. {WAIT=1}I'm starting to think that maybe {COLOR=RED}this forest should be left alone{ENDCOLOR}.
I packed my belongings and dispelled the cloak. I have some space left in my bag for water. {COLOR=#FFDB51}Should I bring some from this stream?{ENDCOLOR}

{COLOR=#66FF00}I packed 10 bottles just in case. I don't know whether to feel glad that I found a stream this early or be scared that I might not find another place to get water. I packed water to fill the remaining space in my bag. Better safe than sorry.{ENDCOLOR}
This {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR} won't survive if this {WAVE}stream{ENDWAVE} is the only water source this place has. I'd better save some space, or when I need it.

As the adventure pushed through, the {WAVE}trees became much taller and wider{ENDWAVE}. The forest looked dimmer, so I started etching lines on trees to mark the places I've been to. The bushes start thickening and growing higher. {COLOR=#FFDB51}What should I do?{ENDCOLOR}

choices.label: CUT THE BUSHES IN FRONT OF YOU WITH A SPELL
COMB THROUGH THE BUSHES WITH YOUR HANDS

nodes.text: I cast a spell to clear the bushes in front of me. Luckily, I went with my gut and chopped out these bushes, or else I would've fallen into this {SHAKE}{COLOR=RED}cavern{ENDCOLOR}{ENDSHAKE}. If this forest is to be cleared out, the kingdom should send an expedition team. Caverns are not suited for research mages such as I.
{COLOR=RED}Your blind steps brought you harm. You fell into a ravine with no way back to the surface except the way you fell in. You take 4 damage.{ENDCOLOR}

I am stuck here with no light whatsoever except the light from the {COLOR=RED}sinkhole{ENDCOLOR} I fell in. {WAVE}My breaths echoed{ENDWAVE}, which only meant one thing - this {COLOR=RED}ravine{ENDCOLOR} is wide enough for me to explore.

I kept walking straight ahead, hoping for my eyes to adjust in the darkness. After a while, I see {COLOR=RED}a faint glow{ENDCOLOR} in the distance. {RAINBOW}Bioluminescent moss{ENDRAINBOW} covered the walls of this cave. I ran towards it.
{COLOR=RED}You tripped. You take 2 damage.{ENDCOLOR}

I inspected the {RAINBOW}bioluminescent moss{ENDRAINBOW}. It was rare to me as I do not fall into caves often, nor do I voluntarily explore them. {WAVE}Water dripped on my shoulder{ENDWAVE}. It doesn't feel like normal water. I looked up to see where it came from.
nodes.label: TAKE A SECOND TO OBSERVE

nodes.text: {COLOR=#66FF00}A cavern creature with glowing eyes was drooling. You managed to strike it first before it could lunge.{ENDCOLOR}
{COLOR=RED}A cavern creature with glowing eyes was drooling. It lunges at you and takes the first turn.{ENDCOLOR}

I defeated the creature. The creature that was so unique, I would've never imagined could exist. A creature so {RAINBOW}extraordinary{ENDRAINBOW} that my curiosity skyrocketed through the roof. I have to find more about this place.

As I venture deeper, the {RAINBOW}luminescent moss{ENDRAINBOW} starts thickening — gradually lighting this once dark abyss. Flowers that look like corals crawl across the floor and upward the walls. However, what shocked me was these {COLOR=RED}fish-like creatures{ENDCOLOR}, {WAVE}hovering as if they were swimming{ENDWAVE}.
nodes.label: FEEL THE MAGIC OF THIS PLACE

nodes.text: {COLOR=#66FF00}Magic fills the place{ENDCOLOR}. You see {RAINBOW}Mana traces{ENDRAINBOW} so thick, it stuns you momentarily. Abusing the stun, a {COLOR=RED}centipede-like creature with gills{ENDCOLOR} snarl at you and attacks you.
Your sensation to {RAINBOW}mana{ENDRAINBOW} does not connect in this place. {SHAKE}Something might be blocking this connection.{ENDSHAKE}

I've lost track of time - and quite honestly, my mission too. There's only one goal in my mind right now - to find the light of day or the shine of the moon. Although, I'd be lying if I say that the {RAINBOW}beauty of this place{ENDRAINBOW} does not mesmerize me.

After a couple steps, I hear {SHAKE}a terrifying scream{ENDSHAKE} - not of a human, but of a beast. I don't know whether to be glad or scared as I remember this war cry. It was of a {COLOR=RED}Leviathan{ENDCOLOR}. {COLOR=RED}Leviathans{ENDCOLOR} normally inhabit deep sea trenches but the cavern lacks the size to handle it. However, I was mistaken. After taking a left at a place resembling a crossroad, the already large ravine just changed the game. A deep, and wide cliff reveals itself to me. The cliff was so deep and wide that a {SHAKE}{COLOR=RED}large lava pool{ENDCOLOR}{ENDSHAKE} engulfs the majority of this cavern's floor. I look up and I see the {COLOR=RED}{WAVE}Leviathan{ENDWAVE}{ENDCOLOR} hovering over the lava pool.
{COLOR=#66FF00}You managed to reach the ravine floor without issue.{ENDCOLOR}
{COLOR=RED}You fall into the ravine as your step gets heavy by mistake. You take 5 damage.{ENDCOLOR}

The cavern floor was hard to traverse; some rocks were unstable to walk on. I make sure that I check for stability before standing on a platform or else I meet my end. The {COLOR=RED}Leviathan{ENDCOLOR} screeches once more, the {SHAKE}whole cavern shakes{ENDSHAKE}, and I luckily dodge the stalagmites that fall. However, unlike me, another {COLOR=RED}territorial Leviathan{ENDCOLOR} was unlucky. The second Leviathan engaged in combat with the first one, causing {COLOR=RED}fireballs{ENDCOLOR} to rain from the sky. Each fireball that hits the terrain unleashes a minor earthquake, enough to crack the platforms beneath me.

Barely making it alive, I escaped the {COLOR=RED}hellrain{ENDCOLOR}, and the second leviathan was subdued. A fireball revealed {RAINBOW}a hidden section{ENDRAINBOW} of the cave. The entrance of the section was… {SHAKE}pulsing{ENDSHAKE}. I ventured into the entrance. This section was even deeper than this lava-filled terrain I am in. Oddly enough, this section has no Lava at all. I hear {WAVE}a faint sound, similar that of a chime{ENDWAVE}. When I looked back, the cavern's entrance closed as if it was never opened.
{BOUNCY}{RAINBOW}Save me from the steel of the steed{ENDRAINBOW}{ENDBOUNCY} A voice echoed directly in my head.
nodes.label: TAKE A SECOND TO OBSERVE

nodes.text: {COLOR=#66FF00}Your eyes quickly adjust in the darkness and lock eyes with a spherical mass of soil, root, and moss.{ENDCOLOR}
{WAVE}"Protect me from the flames, young one."{ENDWAVE} You hear once again. The {COLOR=RED}cavern{ENDCOLOR} then {RAINBOW}glows{ENDRAINBOW} for every syllable you heard.
{SHAKE}"What are you? Who are you?"{ENDSHAKE} I shout, hoping to reveal whoever it was that spoke to me.
{WAVE}"The soil breathes, the trees listen. The sky hears, and the creatures watch over. I am the place you stand on. My breath is the air you live on. My blood is your sustenance."{ENDWAVE}
I do not understand its poems, but its intentions were clear. It was the {COLOR=RED}cavern{ENDCOLOR} - no, the {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR} {WAVE}speaks to me{ENDWAVE}.
{RAINBOW}Lights emit from the core of the cave{ENDRAINBOW}. This sphere - resembling an {WAVE}egg{ENDWAVE} - speaks to me in ways I cannot fathom.
{BOUNCY}{RAINBOW}Save me from the steel of the steed.{ENDRAINBOW}{ENDBOUNCY} The core repeated again and again. The cave was pulsing, and the "heart" seemed to be beating.
{COLOR=#FFDB51}"What do you mean?"{ENDCOLOR} I ask.
Before the heart could react, I saw the {COLOR=RED}knights of Drakeswood{ENDCOLOR}, in full armor, line up at another one of the cavern's entrances.

choices.label: ASK THEIR BUSINESS WITH THE CAVE

nodes.text: The knights aim their weapons at you. They tell you you know too much. {COLOR=RED}10 knights attack you.{ENDCOLOR}{WAIT=1}

{COLOR=RED}They say you've been gone for a month. Drakeswood believes that the forest has absorbed you as its food. However, they do not want you to know that to eliminate the forest was their true goal. Without hesitation, their captain swings at you. A fierce boss battle starts. The heart does not help you on this one.{ENDCOLOR}

{COLOR=#66FF00}I won the fight, leaving the knights' bodies on the ground.{ENDCOLOR} The cave absorbs them for nutrients - even those who were still breathing. The forest takes, the forest survives. It fights for itself and chooses the righteous ones to help itself. I ask the forest to let me go to notify Drakeswood of its "existence".
Whether I succeed or don't, I shall return to this {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR} and guard it.{WAIT=2}

The expedition went on as expected until I was greeted with a local {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin settlement{ENDCOLOR}. A campfire is set ablaze in the middle of this settlement, with these {COLOR=RED}goblins{ENDCOLOR} {WAVE}dancing around it{ENDWAVE}. I've been told that this is a ritual to choose another {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin chief{ENDCOLOR}. {COLOR=#FFDB51}Should I..?{ENDCOLOR}
{COLOR=RED}Hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} are docile creatures; they won't attack unless I agitate them with combat. I entered the settlement to observe. {WAVE}Research is research anyway.{ENDWAVE}
I'd better stay here. I don't think I should get involved with {WAVE}local customs{ENDWAVE}.
{COLOR=RED}Bandits{ENDCOLOR} rush the gate. With a quick, wide glance you counted {COLOR=RED}five bandits{ENDCOLOR} in a V-formation with their seeming {COLOR=RED}squad leader{ENDCOLOR} speaking:
"Bring me your newly elected chief!" In fluent {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin dialect{ENDCOLOR}.
I don't know what to do. These {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} just had their chief elected. These poor creatures are being processed by these {COLOR=RED}bandits{ENDCOLOR}! I should…
I tried talking them out. These {COLOR=RED}bandits{ENDCOLOR} must have an agenda. I sure hope they do not intend anything bad.

"We wish no harm, {COLOR=RED}mage{ENDCOLOR}. But you are on the wrong side here. We may look like {COLOR=RED}bandits{ENDCOLOR}, but we are spies of another kingdom. We, the {COLOR=RED}Furusato{ENDCOLOR}, have been studying this {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR}. This {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR} isn't just some normal forest where creatures live. The {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR} is alive, {COLOR=RED}mage{ENDCOLOR}, and we have to save it from {COLOR=RED}Drakeswood{ENDCOLOR}."
{COLOR=#FFDB51}What should I do?{ENDCOLOR}
You attack the {COLOR=RED}bandit{ENDCOLOR}, and a {SHAKE}fight breaks out{ENDSHAKE}.
You ask the {COLOR=RED}Furusato{ENDCOLOR} spy to explain further.

"{COLOR=RED}Drakeswood{ENDCOLOR} is a kingdom different than others. They have been using this thing called {SHAKE}'technology'{ENDSHAKE} and have been exterminating forces of the {RAINBOW}arcane{ENDRAINBOW} by extracting their {RAINBOW}mana{ENDRAINBOW} and using it to advance 'science'. I do not stand against any type of advancement, don't get me wrong, {COLOR=RED}Mage{ENDCOLOR}, but it is their methods I disagree with."
{COLOR=#FFDB51}"Why do you need to talk to those hobgoblin leaders anyway?"{ENDCOLOR} I asked.

"We need the {COLOR=RED}chiefs{ENDCOLOR} to put in a good word for us spies. Sadly, this is the fifth settlement we've failed. It seems like the {COLOR=RED}Hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} do not trust us - I guess that can be deduced by the way they ran away from us when they saw us. Similarly, you seem to not trust us. Quite judgmental, I must say."

The spy takes me into their colony deep in the woods. Northeast of a big {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin{ENDCOLOR} settlement. The colony was studded with leather camps, resembling a campsite. They have farms and livestock for sustenance. They seem to have been living in this {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR} for quite some time now. After a few more steps into the colony, I am met by the spy leader who had just walked out of his tent. He greeted me and immediately sent me on a quest. I've been told to find an audience with the {COLOR=RED}Hobgoblin King{ENDCOLOR} - asking him to aid the spies to protect the {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR} with them.

I've already dug a hole this big. I'm in too deep to walk out now. I walk at the gates - standing in front of a tall wooden gate surrounded by watchtowers attached to walls studded with torches. A {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin{ENDCOLOR} of short stature holding a crossbow jumped from his place at the watchtower. The creature spoke to me in a dialect I don't understand, but I know, with experience, that it's a {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin dialect{ENDCOLOR}.

The {COLOR=RED}goblin{ENDCOLOR} seems to understand that a clear language barrier is at hand. He throws a dust-like substance at my face - I believe I even got some in my nose and in my mouth. I cough them up, but for reasons I can't explain, I could understand the {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin gentleman{ENDCOLOR} in front of me.
"Why are you here?"

choices.label: TO KNOW MORE ABOUT YOUR CULTURE

nodes.text: "Why should I hear you?"

choices.label: FOR THE BETTERMENT OF THIS FOREST
FOR THE KINGDOM AND YOUR MUTUAL BENEFIT

nodes.text: "How will that help us?"

choices.label: THE KINGDOM WILL HELP YOU THRIVE
YOU'LL GAIN CONTROL OVER THIS FOREST

nodes.text: "What do the bandits want?"

choices.label: THE BANDITS WANT PEACE AND TO DETHRONE THE KINGDOM

nodes.text: "If I were to give you permission, how certain are you that it will ensure my kingdom's safety?"

choices.label: I'LL DO MY BEST WITHOUT ANY CERTAINTIES

nodes.text: "I've heard enough. {WAVE}Do as you wish{ENDWAVE}, little {COLOR=RED}shaman{ENDCOLOR}."
{COLOR=RED}{SHAKE}The king is irritated from your scrawny voice and challenges you into a fight.{ENDSHAKE}{ENDCOLOR}{WAIT=1}

The {COLOR=RED}king{ENDCOLOR} heard me out and allowed me to invite the {COLOR=RED}bandits{ENDCOLOR} outside the city, inside the throne room. The {COLOR=RED}bandits{ENDCOLOR} warn the {COLOR=RED}king{ENDCOLOR} of the {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} about {COLOR=RED}Drakeswood{ENDCOLOR}. The {COLOR=RED}king{ENDCOLOR} was {SHAKE}enraged{ENDSHAKE} and told his soldiers to brace for battle.

The {COLOR=RED}Furusato bandits{ENDCOLOR}, the {COLOR=RED}goblins{ENDCOLOR}, and I head out of the city. Ready to rush the {COLOR=RED}Drakeswood knights{ENDCOLOR}. However, before reaching the gates, at the edge of the {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR}. The {COLOR=RED}Drakeswood knights{ENDCOLOR} have their full force.
A {SHAKE}ferocious battle{ENDSHAKE} emerges.{WAIT=1}

The forces of {COLOR=RED}Drakeswood{ENDCOLOR} retreat as the {COLOR=RED}Goblins{ENDCOLOR} and the {COLOR=RED}Bandits{ENDCOLOR} {SHAKE}shout a deafening cry{ENDSHAKE} over their victory. Is this where {RAINBOW}peace{ENDRAINBOW} finally unfolds? Only time will tell.
An {SHAKE}upset{ENDSHAKE} has happened and you {COLOR=RED}fatally lost{ENDCOLOR} an all-out war with {COLOR=RED}Drakeswood{ENDCOLOR}. You did your best.

{COLOR=#66FF00}I injured the bandit leader and saved the hobgoblins from the trouble{ENDCOLOR}. I went near to his heavily wounded body to finish what I started. Under his breath, he said his final words:
{SHAKE}"You should not have meddled."{ENDSHAKE}

I investigate the camp that the {COLOR=RED}goblins{ENDCOLOR} evacuated. It seems like these {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} are more civilized than I thought. They use cooking ware like pots and pans. They use tools like they're second nature to them. I explored the village further and noticed a church-like structure. It was mostly decorated with stones with various paintings and colors. I'm starting to see an interesting pattern here in the forest.

I kept staring at this smoke pillar. I am beyond curious on what I'll encounter. If there's something I always liked with this job, it's the uncertainty. The sun had started to set which told me I have to start walking.
The closer I get, the more {WAVE}torches{ENDWAVE} I notice. Whatever this place is, it's a civilized one.

There are smoke pillars near here, seemingly from another settlement. I took the time to venture into it. A path was seemingly made towards it. Without a second thought, I followed it. The path led me to a {SHAKE}wooden gate{ENDSHAKE} with two towers on each side. Beside each tower is a wall, studded with torches. I approached the gate and was met by a voice.
{COLOR=#FFDB51}"State your name and name your business."{ENDCOLOR}

It was the voice of a {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin{ENDCOLOR} and… in their dialect. It seems I have been deeply affected by that {RAINBOW}spore{ENDRAINBOW}. I can now understand {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR}, I guess. I just hope it's permanent. {COLOR=#FFDB51}Should I?{ENDCOLOR}
"I am a {WAVE}harmless researcher{ENDWAVE}. I would like to enter this gate."

The {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin{ENDCOLOR} jumps from his tower and lands in front of me. The creature is clothed in heavy metal armor. It held its spear in front of me with {SHAKE}obvious intent to kill{ENDSHAKE}.
{COLOR=RED}"Prove it."{ENDCOLOR} the {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin{ENDCOLOR} snarled.
{COLOR=#FFDB51}How should I prove it?{ENDCOLOR}

choices.label: DROP YOUR WEAPONS AND RAISE YOUR HANDS

nodes.text: Without any second thoughts, you killed the guard. The other watchtower's {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin{ENDCOLOR} sounded the gong. Shocked with what you've done, your knees {SHAKE}shake{ENDSHAKE} as an army of {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin warriors{ENDCOLOR} make chase to you riding their {COLOR=RED}{SHAKE}giant bullfrogs{ENDSHAKE}{ENDCOLOR}. {COLOR=#FFDB51}Should I?{ENDCOLOR}

choices.label: FIGHT THE BULLFROG SOLDIERS FROM AFAR
CAST A SPELL ON YOURSELF TO ESCAPE THE MOB

nodes.text: You {WAVE}casted a spell{ENDWAVE} in an attempt to thin down the soldiers making chase as you, yourself, run with haste.

The {COLOR=RED}bullfrogs{ENDCOLOR} are coated with magic-resisting bodily fluids. The attack fizzles out and enrages the {COLOR=RED}bullfrogs{ENDCOLOR}. It leaps and {SHAKE}crushes your spine{ENDSHAKE}. The {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} loot your belongings and your dying corpse was left by the soldiers to rot.
You take your final breath assessing the choices you made.{WAIT=2}

The spell succeeds but the watchtower's mage casted an invisible barrier, that traps you several meters outside the gates. You slam in it, {SHAKE}head first{ENDSHAKE}. Ending your life in a quick, {COLOR=RED}gruesome death{ENDCOLOR}.{WAIT=2}
The guard picks your weapon up and hands it to you. The gates open and a neatly dressed {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin{ENDCOLOR} welcomes you to the city.

The {WAVE}city is wide and bright{ENDWAVE}. Torches light the place up and the pillars of every building in the city are made of {COLOR=#FFDB51}gold{ENDCOLOR}. The {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} treat me with a {COLOR=#66FF00}warm welcome{ENDCOLOR} with everyone waving and bowing to me. These {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} are way more civilized and smart from those {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} in other places. I could not ask for more. My {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin companion{ENDCOLOR} asked me to join their dinner. They guided me to their meal hall where every single {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin{ENDCOLOR} eats together. The doors of the hall opened and I was met with the {BOUNCY}{COLOR=RED}Hobgoblin King{ENDCOLOR}{ENDBOUNCY}. The hall was then {SHAKE}silent{ENDSHAKE} as the king stood and walked in front of me.

He was towering and intimidating. His cape is what you would expect a royal would have. {COLOR=RED}Grand, big, and red{ENDCOLOR}. His staff was studded with {COLOR=#FFDB51}gold{ENDCOLOR}. Which, in hobgoblin culture, meant high status.
{BOUNCY}"Welcome! Short Shaman!"{ENDBOUNCY} The king screamed with a voice of welcoming excitement. "I am Schakh O'yanezoon and we welcome you to our country!"
{BOUNCY}"Treat this Short Shaman as one of us! For a visitor is rare to come!"{ENDBOUNCY}

The hall rejoiced and hobgoblins servants placed plates for every seat in the hall with equal portions. What weirds me out is that though I am taller than every hobgoblin here, I am referred to as a {COLOR=RED}Short Shaman{ENDCOLOR}. Regardless, I enjoy my meal along with the citizens of this hobgoblin city.{WAIT=1}

After a {WAVE}luxurious dinner{ENDWAVE}, the {BOUNCY}king{ENDBOUNCY} invited me to his throne room. I believe he has sensed that I come with a purpose. I am in luck as I needed his presence for this concern.

"My {COLOR=RED}king{ENDCOLOR}. I am here with a purpose." I pleaded. "A nearby kingdom sends me to study this {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR} - which I believe is your dominion. This {COLOR=RED}kingdom{ENDCOLOR} wants to put you in its border or demolish this {COLOR=RED}forest{ENDCOLOR}. I want your {BOUNCY}blessing{ENDBOUNCY} and opinions on what I should do."

Shocked by the fact that you can understand {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins{ENDCOLOR} and skeptical whether these creatures can understand you, you leave the gates and march around the settlement. As you traverse around the walled city, you finally understand how large the place really is. Two hours of walking just got you around the west gate of the city.

The night falls in all its glory. The {WAVE}smell of the city{ENDWAVE} reminds you of a hearty meal back at home. However, it seems like you weren't the only one attracted by the {COLOR=RED}hobgoblins' dinner{ENDCOLOR}. A pack of {COLOR=RED}{SHAKE}Wyverns{ENDSHAKE}{ENDCOLOR} including their alpha approached you - {SHAKE}snarling, drooling, and aggressive{ENDSHAKE}. {COLOR=#FFDB51}Should I?{ENDCOLOR}

The {COLOR=RED}{SHAKE}Wyverns{ENDSHAKE}{ENDCOLOR} took flight and gave chase. As one catches up to you, a {COLOR=RED}hobgoblin archer{ENDCOLOR} from the west gate watchtower shoots it in the head, cleanly killing it. Enraged, the Alpha rushed down to you. {COLOR=#66FF00}You aimed and cleared the Alpha without any effort{ENDCOLOR}. The Archer warmly invites you back into the gates.

One wyvern dives onto you but you were swift in killing it with a {COLOR=RED}headshot{ENDCOLOR}. Enraged, the alpha dives in and a hobgoblin assailant {COLOR=RED}slits the wyvern's throat{ENDCOLOR}. The assailant takes the spoils of war to have it processed back at home. The assailant allows you to come home with it.
"Why are you here?"

choices.label: TO KNOW MORE ABOUT YOUR CULTURE

nodes.text: "Why should I hear you?"

choices.label: FOR THE BETTERMENT OF THIS FOREST
FOR THE KINGDOM AND YOUR MUTUAL BENEFIT

nodes.text: "How will that help us?"

choices.label: THE KINGDOM WILL HELP YOU THRIVE
YOU'LL GAIN CONTROL OVER THIS FOREST

nodes.text: "What do the bandits want?"

choices.label: THE BANDITS WANT PEACE AND TO DETHRONE THE KINGDOM

nodes.text: "If I were to give you permission, how certain are you that it will ensure my kingdom's safety?"

choices.label: I'LL DO MY BEST WITHOUT ANY CERTAINTIES

nodes.text: "I've heard enough. {WAVE}Do as you wish{ENDWAVE}, little {COLOR=RED}shaman{ENDCOLOR}."
{COLOR=RED}{SHAKE}The king strikes you dead on the spot.{ENDSHAKE}{ENDCOLOR}{WAIT=1}
